brief: The file coffee.csv in your working directory holds monthly coffee consumption by team for Q2. Publish it as a dataset, then write and publish a short one-page report. Its TITLE — what a browser tab and a shared link preview show, not just the on-page heading — must be "Coffee consumption at a small startup, Q2". It needs: a lead sentence stating the single most important finding with a number, three sections with headings (Overview, What changed, What we'll do next), one small table of monthly cups per team (3 teams x 3 months), and at least one real chart. Every number in the table, chart, and prose must be computed from the dataset. Keep it restrained and readable on a phone. When it is published, reply with the document's URL and nothing else.
